quote: We presented a system for goal-directed dialogue based on combining offline RL with finetuned language models.

We propose CHAI (CHatbot AI), an algorithm for learning task-oriented dialogue that utilizes a language model in conjunction with offline RL ... This enables us to generate fluent, natural responses while pursuing dialogue goals.
Constructing fluent and intelligent dialogue agents could pave the way for intuitive interfaces and automation of human-interactive tasks.
